note: Pairs the duplicate gate flagged and a reviewer judged to be DIFFERENT cases. A pair may ship only if it is listed here with the reason. Key: ids sorted and joined by '|'.

pairs.ticket_follow_on_whatsapp|ticket_whatsap: How the button works (it is visible) vs why it is not visible (support WhatsApp number not configured): different questions, different answers, and the second is only asked by someone who cannot see the first.
pairs.wa_change_connected_number|whatsapp_numb: Different cases on the same number: whatsapp_number_not_linked is a number that failed to connect (a fault to diagnose); wa_change_connected_number is a working, connected number the customer wants to swap for another (a request with its own steps and Meta limits). Same lexicon, different decision.
